notes.title: Upcoming release, new price
notes.notes:
Just to give you a heads-up: a major update for AudioSpace is on its way! It will include a new visualization mode as well as a certain highly requested feature, together with some smaller fixes and improvements. No exact release date yet, but most likely it will happen before mid-October.

With this release, price of AudioSpace will also be updated to reflect the added value of all the new visualization modes, configuration options and other features since the launch. As all updates are free for the existing owners of AudioSpace, now would be an excellent time to buy it if you have been considering to do so! ⏳😉
